_written: 2026-10-09 ~19:00 UTC, BEFORE any free-energy profile from the runs below was computed. Seen beforehand: (i) the 2026-10-04 consistency summary (results/wca_replica_ladder/consistency/summary.json: RMS(F_mf - F_density) 0.284 / 0.051 / 0.018 at dt 0.002 / 0.001 / 0.0005, noise ~0.004); (ii) a 14-chain pilot of src/wca_validation.py (100-tu chains, energies, acceptance rates, clip counts; NO profiles): <U> ~ 11 kT for MC/MALA/LM/BAOAB and EM_IMPL dt 0.0005, <U> ~ 1043 kT for EM_IMPL dt 0.002 with a solvent pair inside min_r in 2.8 % of steps and the force clip binding in 29 % of steps; MALA acceptance 0.67 / 0.87 / 0.96 at dt 5e-4 / 2.5e-4 / 1e-4; LM_TRUE (no clip) blew up at dt 0.002.
purpose: Decide, from criteria independent of any ABF/FR outcome, whether the production WCA overdamped integrator samples the intended Gibbs measure exp(-beta U) of the stated potential (WCA + double-well dimer + RC wall, beta 1, 100 particles, a 1.5) to a stated tolerance, and at which dt.
intended_model: U(q) = sum_{pairs != (0,1)} V_WCA(r) + V_dim(r_01) + U_wall(z); V_WCA = 4[(1/r)^12-(1/r)^6]+1 for r < 2^(1/6); V_dim = 2(1-u^2)^2, u = (r - 2^(1/6) - 2)/2; z = (r_01 - 2^(1/6))/4; U_wall = 40[(z-1.2)_+^2 + (-0.2-z)_+^2]; box 15 x 15 periodic. NO force clip, NO min_r clamp (these are numerical regularisations of the production code, not part of the physical model).

arbiters.MC: Metropolis Monte Carlo on U: single-particle uniform displacements (delta 0.4) + dimer-stretch moves (uniform dr in [-0.8, 0.8], 20 per sweep, acceptance with the 2-D Jacobian r'/r). Exact for exp(-beta U); uses the energy only (no force). 64 chains, seeds 9100-9163, burn-in 20000 sweeps from a lattice start, 3e7 sweeps each.
arbiters.MALA: EM proposal at dt 2.5e-4 with Metropolis-Hastings correction on U. Exact. 32 chains, seeds 9200-9231, 1.2288e8 steps (30720 tu of proposals) after 80000 burn-in steps.

candidates.EM_IMPL: the PRODUCTION unbiased dynamics (wca_numba.run_ladder_point with abf_bias_scale 0, accepted clips: force_clip 250, min_r 0.65, mean-force sample clip 500), N = 1, 30720 tu per seed after a 20-tu burn-in; dt in {0.002, 0.001, 0.0005, 0.00025, 0.000125}; seeds: the 2026-10-04 runs 3600-3631 (dt 0.002/0.001/0.0005, burn-in 10000 steps) + new 3632-3663 at those dt; 3600-3663 at dt 0.00025 and 0.000125
candidates.LM_TRUE: Leimkuhler-Matthews on -grad U (no clip), dt in {0.001, 0.0005, 0.00025}, 32 seeds 9300-9331, 30720 tu after 20 tu burn-in
candidates.BAOAB: underdamped Langevin, unit mass, gamma 1, -grad U, dt in {0.005, 0.0025, 0.00125}, 32 seeds 9400-9431, 30720 tu after 20 tu burn-in
candidates.EM_IMPL_diag: src/wca_validation.py harness of the production drift (regularisation counters, <U>), dt in {0.002, 0.001, 0.0005, 0.00025, 0.000125}, 16 seeds 9500-9515, 3072 tu each, diag every step

profiles: 160 bins on [-0.2, 1.2]; compared on bin centres inside the eval window [-0.1, 1.1] after subtracting each profile's mean over that window. F_density = -kT log C_j. F_MF = cumulative trapezoid of bin-mean local mean forces over bin centres. Uncertainty: leave-one-seed-out jackknife (chains are independent; samples within a chain are never treated as independent).
statistic: D(A,B) = debiased RMS over the window of F_A - F_B: sqrt(max(0, RMS_obs^2 - mean_j(se_j^2))), with se_j the jackknife standard error of the per-bin difference; 95 % upper bound from a seed bootstrap (2000 resamples, independent resampling of the two ensembles) of the debiased statistic.

gates.G_F_force: intended analytic force vs central differences of the intended energy: max relative error < 1e-6 on smooth configurations (no pair within 1e-4 of the cutoff); production raw force (wca_numba.wca_force, torch engine) equals the analytic force to 1e-10 relative on configurations with every pair outside min_r; sum of unclipped forces = 0 to 1e-10 max|F|
gates.G_MC_self: MC and MALA reproduce the analytic dimer-only density p(z) ~ r exp(-beta(V_dim + U_wall)) (chi-square over the window, p > 0.001); in the full system D(MC, MALA) consistent with 0 (95 % upper bound <= 0.0075)
gates.G_MF_formula: in the MC (exact Gibbs) chains D(F_MF_true, F_density) <= 0.005 (validates the mean-force estimator, Jacobian term included, independently of any dynamics)
gates.G_dyn_admissible: a (scheme, dt) is ADMISSIBLE for physical free energies if D(F_density(scheme,dt), F_density(MC)) <= 0.005 with 95 % upper bound <= 0.0075, AND D(F_MF(scheme,dt), F_density(MC)) <= 0.005 (upper <= 0.0075), AND no chain blew up. MARGINAL if both D <= 0.010; FAIL otherwise.
gates.timestep_choice: the production timestep for any new WCA ABF/FR experiment is the LARGEST dt at which EM_IMPL is ADMISSIBLE. If EM_IMPL is admissible at no dt in the ladder, the WCA dynamics gate is UNRESOLVED and no new WCA FR experiment is run. The choice uses ONLY the profiles above, never an ABF or FR outcome.

secondary: <U>, P(z > 0.5), Delta F_wells = -kT log[P(0.75<=z<=1.1)/P(-0.1<=z<=0.25)], clip-binding and min_r frequencies, max step displacement, MALA/MC acceptance, BAOAB momentum moments (mean 0, variance kT, skewness 0, excess kurtosis 0) and NVE energy error scaling, observed weak order of the dt-dependence (fit with uncertainties; not inferred from 3 noisy points).
